title: Design the universe, characters, creatures, and visual language first, then…
content:
Design the universe, characters, creatures, and visual language first, then move on to animation in Seedance 2.

Use Agent One in Seedance 2 (on InVideo) to develop the universe, organize ideas, generate shots, create animations, and edit sequences.

Render your Seedance 2.0 output in 4K (e.g., via Pollo AI) for higher-resolution final video.
